manual.machine_components.line2: Outside of paracausal events and the ability to modify the size of atoms, fitting complex heavy machinery into a meter cube seems impossible.{0}
manual.machine_components.line3: In order to create more complex machines than simple furnaces and storage silos, component machinery must first be assembled.{0}
manual.machine_components.line4: Engineering Blocks are used alongside simpler components such as {0}scaffolding{1} to construct heavy machinery.{2}
